# Report #902: citation extension to library-icon-tests and vi-actor-core-native-gap

Wrote `benchmark/challenges/citation-extend-0210.md` (the only file written; no existing file changed). Measured with `.session/artifacts/measure_0210.py`, `measure2_0210.py` and `measure3_0210.py`, run as `python3 -B -I`. `python3 -B -I benchmark/scripts/score.py --check` printed 35 matches and 0 mismatches. No LabVIEW is available, so nothing here says anything about native behaviour.

Findings:
- Both fixtures are scored: both are in `FIXTURES` (score.py:21). The generic `citation_resolves` / `citations_resolve` / `combine_grounding` (score.py:146, 169, 218) already exists, so the design in citation-gap-0206 line 67 is mostly out of date. No per-fixture scorer code is needed.
- `library-icon-tests`: A0001-A0010 each carry 1 dict citation in the dev file (10 in total). One more citation is a string, in `answer_record_contract`. An XML key exists (`positive-control-key-0204-icon-tests.json`, agreed in sessions 877/878). Verdict: ready to extend. The only remaining work is rewriting that string citation to the dict form. That changes the dev file, so it forces re-pins in `input-pins.json` (lines 20, 27 and the `results/challenges.json` entry) and `preparation.json` (lines 63, 135, 289 and the `results/challenges.json` entry).
- `vi-actor-core-native-gap`: 0 dict citations, no XML key (oracle status `unavailable`) and a binary `.vi` artifact. Verdict: not applicable.

Not done: I did not locate the exact line of the string citation in the dev file. I did not check whether `c1-challenges-0125-pins.json`, `lineage.json`, `reviews-0128/c1-artifact-manifest-0126.json` and `preparation-status.json` are live pin maps. I did not test the icon-tests controls against real bytes with `LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT` unset.

`git status --porcelain` printed nothing, though the file was written. I did not investigate. The parent may have already imported it.

## Discoveries
- citation-gap-0206 says the extension applies "when they are scored", but both fixtures are already scored and the generic check already runs (`benchmark/scripts/score.py:21`, `:146`).

## What next
The shaper can order a small task on `benchmark/cases/dev/library-icon-tests.json`. That task rewrites the string citation, re-pins the entries listed above, regenerates `results/challenges.json` and runs `--check`. It should first confirm which of the unchecked pin files are live. Do not re-measure the scorer.
